QuestInfo.name: More than a Feeling
QuestInfo.0: It's getting late. Talk with Xiao Xiao, then return to the school.
QuestInfo.1: Climb the mountain, defeating the rampaging beasts and Stump Spooks along the way.
QuestInfo.2:
A strange feeling grows the closer you get to the Xuanshan School as peculiar memories enter your mind. 
You have a bad feeling about this. 
...Hopefully, it's nothing.
